decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's stated direction toward binding mobile communication, so it likely meets aspirations and needs no problemistic search, although it was only ever mentioned and never given its own page.
Its promotion to a page of its own in 2019 signals results at or above aspiration, and as an architecture underpinning the core offer it ties into the firm's main resources.
The hardware token got its own page in 2019 and serves regulated strong-authentication demand, and the firm's slack lets it carry a niche hardware line whose volumes are still uncertain.

A payment compliance suite fits banking customers' regulatory needs, but it stayed at mention level and is more peripheral to the identity ecosystem, so it is a moderate candidate for redirecting resources if it falls short.
